name: AI pipeline (offline)
description: Sends explicit Library-search requests in short and long synthetic conversations against an indexed Library of 300 notes and a local fast mock provider. Measures real retrieval, context compilation, database work, persistence and UI publication; no API calls.
initialConditions: Fresh disposable profile, 1280x840 window, Research layout, one chat view. Fixture: seed 11, a Library of 300 synthetic notes (indexed), conversations 'Lab Short' (6 messages) and 'Lab Long' (400 messages). Provider: the local mock ('fast': one short reply, no delay). No API calls.

methods.seedChats: fixture: UiLab.seedChats writes the conversations, and with files a synthetic Library it then indexes, to the test profile's database
methods.refreshChats: store-call: ChatStore.refresh (what the app does on start)
methods.selectChat: store-call: ChatStore.selectChat (what picking a conversation in the side panel does)
methods.sendChatMessage: store-call: ChatStore.sendMessage (what the composer's Send does)
